name: Kisaragi Suzu
source:
The main heroine of Ayakashibito. A [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kitsune]Kitsune[/url] youkai girl that follows [url=/c281]Soushichi[/url] around ever since their escape. She hates every human with the exception of Soushichi. She claims she is Soushichi’s older sister due to her real age, but really doesn't act like one, she's more of a stubborn girl.
Has amazing powers called Soul of Language, whereas she can [spoiler]command other people around who feel compelled in following her orders[/spoiler]. Feels that Soushichi is always too kind and a little too naive.

[Edited from [url=http://accany.wordpress.com/2009/06/19/%E3%81%82%E3%82%84%E3%81%8B%E3%81%97%E3%81%B3%E3%81%A8-review/]a review[/url] by Accany]
